title: Adaptive Prioritization Radar: Dynamic RICE + Velocity & Risk Multipliers
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Design and pilot an "adaptive prioritization radar" that extends classic RICE to surface items that are high business value but at risk because of execution velocity, operational cost, or latency impact. Motivation: The current RICE spreadsheets treat Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort as static inputs; teams report repeated re-ranking after velocity changes, and infra/latency costs are underweighted. This ticket defines a reproducible scoring formula, UI wireframe for the Console roadmap radar, and a 3-project pilot to validate thresholds.
scoring_model: 1) Base RICE: ScoreRICE = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort. 2) Execution velocity multiplier (V): V = 1 + clamp((team_velocity_norm - baseline_velocity), -0.35, 0.6) * 0.5. Higher proven velocity increases score; lower velocity reduces it. 3) Cost-latency risk multiplier (R): R = 1 - min(0.5, risk_index * 0.4) where risk_index is a 0.0-1.0 composite of expected per-token cost delta and predicted 95th-pct latency impact normalized against platform baselines. 4) Final AdaptiveScore = ScoreRICE * V * R. Example: RICE=120, V=1.12, R=0.84 => AdaptiveScore=113. The radar will bucket scores into Quick Wins, Invest, Watch, Deprioritize (top to bottom).
operationalization_notes: - Team velocity is pulled from Cycle throughput and blocked rate; baseline_velocity is the org median. - Risk index formula will be computed from Redwood Optimize outputs: estimated per-token change + latency delta normalized to [0,1]. - Implementation: API to score items + frontend radar visualization in Console roadmap. - Backfill historical scores for past 6 months to validate distribution and thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence doc describing formula and rationale published and reviewed by PM/Eng/Design
Spreadsheet and automated script that computes AdaptiveScore for a CSV of tickets
Console prototype wireframe (Figma link) approved by Design
Pilot run on 3 active initiatives with before/after prioritization review notes
Dashboard showing distribution of AdaptiveScore and category assignments
